forecast.subtitle: Plan sowing, spraying, irrigation and harvest with daily weather trends
forecast.recDay1: Ideal sunshine for field scouting, light weeding, and foliar spray application.
forecast.recDay2: Increasing cloud cover by afternoon. Complete morning chemical sprays before 11 AM.
forecast.recDay3: Severe thunderstorm risk. Suspend all spraying and open drainage channels immediately.
forecast.recDay4: Heavy downpours expected. Postpone irrigation and protect stacked harvest bags.
forecast.recDay5: Light scattered showers clearing up by late evening. Check waterlogging in low spots.
forecast.recDay6: Bright sunshine returning. Safe to resume field operations and soil drying.
forecast.recDay7: Favorable weather for normal irrigation cycles, fertilizer top-dressing, and harvest.

alert.title: Severe Weather Warnings & Advisories
alert.subtitle: Official meteorological bulletins & actionable farm disaster mitigation
alert.imdHeadline: IMD Red Alert: Squall and heavy downpours expected across coastal and central Andhra Pradesh
alert.descriptionText: An active low-pressure depression over the Bay of Bengal is predicted to cause widespread thunderstorms with squally winds (45-55 km/h) and heavy precipitation (65-115 mm) over the next 48 hours. Farmers are advised to take precautionary safeguards for standing crops and irrigation infrastructure.
alert.paddyImpact: Water stagnation risk in flowering stage and lodging risk due to gusty winds.
alert.paddyAdvisory: Clear bund outlets and open field drainage trenches to drain excess water within 12 hours.
alert.cottonImpact: Square and boll shedding hazard due to prolonged waterlogging and root asphyxiation.
alert.cottonAdvisory: Create sub-surface trenches across slopes; do not spray pesticides during rainfall.
alert.chilliImpact: Anthracnose fruit rot development risk and wilt caused by water-saturated soil.
alert.chilliAdvisory: Spray copper oxychloride (3g/L) immediately after rain subsides; avoid water accumulation.
alert.action1: Inspect and clean field drainage channels immediately to prevent waterlogging.
alert.action2: Move harvested produce and bags to elevated, watertight indoor storage or tarpaulin sheds.
alert.action3: Anchor temporary farm machinery, sprayers, and nursery shade nets against squalls.
alert.action4: Shift livestock away from low-lying pastures and high-tension electrical lines.
alert.dont1: Do not apply chemical fertilizers or pesticides during or immediately prior to rain.
alert.dont2: Do not seek shelter under isolated trees, metal structures, or near power poles during lightning.
alert.dont3: Do not leave irrigation motors or electric pumps connected in flood-prone farm plots.
